notes: Correction: 'he hath' was split off from the ʾên unit as its own added unit. Rule 43 places an English 'have' on whatever makes the clause possessive and, where nothing does, marks it added together with the subject supplied beside it; rule 50 keeps only a supplied dummy with the existential, and the 'he' of this clause is referential.
ʾên keeps the 'no' written for it and heads on the negation word (rule 50).
